change: The required find_symbol parameter name became symbol_name, without a compatibility alias. Graph lookup semantics and results are otherwise unchanged.
limitations: The unchanged historical parser and graph engine populate a synthetic graph before server startup. No tool function is replaced.
Only the actual MCP find_symbol path is evaluated; embedding/index/search workflows and their heavy optional runtime stack are not reproduced.
setup: Unmodified historical source plus external synthetic-fixture bootstrap; no host mounts or network at runtime.
